messages.content: Book a room for 2 adults and a child at the Sheraton Hotel in New York with check-in on May 1, 2022 and check-out on May 5, 2022. Also, Book a room for 1 adult and 2 children at the Marriott in Los Angeles with check-in on June 1, 2022 and check-out on June 10, 2022.

function.name: hotel_booking_book
function.description: Book a hotel room at the specified location for the specified number of adults and children. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the hotel is located.

check_in.description: The check-in date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.

check_out.description: The check-out date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.

adults.description: The number of adults for the booking.

children.description: The number of children for the booking.
